about: A person or body named by name (docs/design/names-and-dates.md section 4; contracts/calls.md, `ambiguous`): what both resolvers (translator/src/resolver.ts and kernel/crates/resolver) must make of each program, from what this seat has been shown, in a world whose people have names (`names` true, the default here) and in one without (`names` false: the old answers, word for word). Each case has `blocks` (the acts) or `asks` (the questions back, whole) and, where the resolver answers `ambiguous`, `ambiguous` (the answer as data).

cases.name: a name the seat knows one person by is that person
cases.program: message(to="José Muñoz García", text="Your hearing is on Monday.")

cases.name: written without its marks, a name that finds one person is that person
cases.program: message(to="Jose Munoz Garcia", text="Your hearing is on Monday.")

cases.name: a name the seat knows two people by is asked back, with what tells them apart on its own file
cases.program: message(to="Mary Wanjiru", text="Your hearing is on Monday.")
asks: Which "Mary Wanjiru" do you mean (for to)? You know of 2 by that name: Mary Wanjiru (c0002), who wrote rec.80 (an application), party to lease-0042 (a lease); or Mary Wanjiru (c0003), to whom rec.71 (a notice) is addressed. Name the one you mean by their id.

known_by: to whom rec.71 (a notice) is addressed

cases.name: the same, the name in a list
cases.program: message(to=["Mary Wanjiru"], text="Your hearing is on Monday.")
asks: Which "Mary Wanjiru" do you mean (for to)? You know of 2 by that name: Mary Wanjiru (c0002), who wrote rec.80 (an application), party to lease-0042 (a lease); or Mary Wanjiru (c0003), to whom rec.71 (a notice) is addressed. Name the one you mean by their id.

known_by: to whom rec.71 (a notice) is addressed

cases.name: two of one name that nothing on the file tells apart: said so
cases.program: message(to="Peter Otieno", text="Your hearing is on Monday.")
asks: Which "Peter Otieno" do you mean (for to)? You know of 2 by that name: Peter Otieno (c0005), with nothing on your file to tell them apart but the id; or Peter Otieno (c0006), with nothing on your file to tell them apart but the id. Name the one you mean by their id.

cases.name: two posts of one title are asked back the same way
cases.program: message(to="the clerk", text="Please list the case.")
asks: Which "the clerk" do you mean (for to)? You know of 2 by that name: clerk-a, the post of Clerk at Nakuru Rent Tribunal (tribunal); or clerk-b, the post of Clerk at Nakuru Rent Tribunal (tribunal). Name the one you mean by their id.

known_by: the post of Clerk at Nakuru Rent Tribunal (tribunal)
the post of Clerk at Nakuru Rent Tribunal (tribunal)

cases.name: a name nobody the seat knows goes by is not on file with the office (never looked up anywhere else)
cases.program: message(to="Hanna Mueller", text="Your hearing is on Monday.")
asks: No Hanna Mueller is on file with this office.

cases.name: as itself, not on its file
asks: No Grace Akinyi is on your file.

cases.name: a list with one name it knows and one it does not
asks: No Grace Akinyi is on file with this office.

cases.name: a translator that writes none(ambiguous) has said what it cannot know: unclear
asks: It isn't clear what should happen. Could you say it more plainly?

cases.name: names off: two of one name are asked back as they always were
cases.program: message(to="Mary Wanjiru", text="Your hearing is on Monday.")
asks: More than one to is called "Mary Wanjiru": c0002, c0003. Which one?

cases.name: names off: a name nobody goes by, as it always was
cases.program: message(to="Hanna Mueller", text="Your hearing is on Monday.")
asks: You don't know of anyone or anything called "Hanna Mueller" (for to).

cases.name: names off: a list is passed on as written
